artifact.summary: One-qubit circuit for the five-segment control sequence Rz(a1) Rn(b1) Rz(a2) Rn(b2) Rz(a3) applied in time order. Rn(b)=Ry(theta)Rz(b)Ry(-theta) with n=(sin theta,0,cos theta). The angles, theta and an optional r are supplied by the instance. The classical time-optimal search, the cost evaluation and the angle bounds are not part of the circuit.
register_layout: qubit 0: the single data qubit; Qiskit index 0 is the least significant bit; no ancilla

equation_mapping.explanation: Rn(b)=Ry(theta)Rz(b)Ry(-theta) is built as ry(-theta), rz(b), ry(theta) in circuit order. Ry(theta) takes z to (sin theta,0,cos theta) under the standard convention.
The five alternating segments are appended in time order a1, b1, a2, b2, a3 for caller-supplied angles. The angles are not computed by the circuit.
Total time is a classical cost used in the search. The circuit does not compute it; r is only validated as positive.
The fidelity check is performed by the external runner and is not part of the operation.
The bounded classical search for time-optimal angles is not implemented. The paper's angle bounds are unavailable.

specification_changes.change: Scope narrowed to the circuit for a given set of five angles, with no search and no determination of the free angles.
specification_changes.reason: Which angles are free and the angle bounds are unresolved, and the operation must be a pure bound unitary circuit.

specification_changes.change: The segments are applied in time order a1 first, so the matrix product is Rz(a3)Rn(b2)Rz(a2)Rn(b1)Rz(a1), the reverse of the left-to-right form written in eq_2.
specification_changes.reason: The step description states time order and Qiskit applies gates in circuit order. The written product would correspond to reversing the angle lists.

specification_changes.change: r is only validated as positive and not used in the gates. The clockwise_only option enforces angles in [0,2pi).
specification_changes.reason: Rotation angles determine the unitary, and r only affects the time cost.

assumptions: theta lies in (0, pi/2], so the axes are non-parallel
The five-segment ordering Rz, Rn, Rz, Rn, Rz is used
Rotation angles use the Qiskit convention rz(a)=exp(-i a Z/2)
unresolved_issues: The paper's explicit angle bounds are unknown
Which three angles are the free parameters, and the closed-form solution, are unknown
The exact definition of r is unknown
Shorter sequences than five segments are handled only by setting angles to zero
The Ry sign convention should be verified by simulation

validation.detail: Circuit built and transpiled successfully; no independent correctness reference selected.
